subject: Vendr evidence sampling / short-term log access exemption request

Cc: security.operations@fincrest.com
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal: evidence sampling exemption question

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Our security team started the Vendr profile intake and there are a couple of items they flagged where we need a slightly different approach than a full evidence export.

Short version: we have high-volume ephemeral logs (payment routing debug traces) that contain tokenized PII. For compliance reasons we cannot push a full 90-day log dump to a third-party portal. The security questionnaire (SIG / CAIQ) lists those items under logging/forensics, and the procurement team asked whether Redwood can accept a sampling exemption: provide a 7-day sample plus an attestation and short-term presigned access for additional artifacts if auditors request them.

Questions for you:
- Is there an existing Vendr/Whistic process Redwood follows for sampling exemptions?
- Can you provide a standard attestation or letter?
- What presign TTL can you support if we need to request additional logs for an audit?

We can supply a scoped list of fields and a short justification for the exemption. If a different workflow (e.g., signed NDA + ephemeral S3 presign) is required, let us know. We need to close intake by 03/26 to hit our vendor onboarding deadline.

Appreciate the help — Mike

--
Mike Tremblay
Sr. InfoSec Manager, FinCrest Payments

Subject: Re: Vendr portal: evidence sampling exemption question

Jonas / Ben — background and proposal:

1) Precedent: we’ve handled similar requests during onboarding for payments customers where raw logs contain tokenized PII. Our standard pattern is:
   - Provide a scoped sample (7 days) in the portal as requested
   - Supply a signed attestation that the sample represents our retention/collection practice for the control IDs in SIG/CAIQ
   - Offer presigned, time-limited access to additional artifacts for auditor requests, gated by a documented request process and an approval runbook

2) Presign TTLs: default = 30 days for presigned bundles; exceptions up to 90 days are possible but require Legal approval and a short written justification from the customer. For PII-containing artifacts we prefer 30 days and require an access log and confirmed S3 lifecycle policy.

3) Evidence artifacts + minimality: we avoid exporting full production logs to the portal. Instead we produce filtered extracts and a hashed manifest so the customer/attestor can map items back to the original dataset without moving bulk PII into the vendor portal. See attached presign-ttl-notes.pdf for internal guidance.

4) Next steps I recommend we propose to FinCrest:
   - 7-day sample in Vendr (we will redact token values and include field-level hash mapping)
   - Signed exemption attestation from Redwood (I can draft using our template)
   - Up to 30-day presigned bundles on request; 90-day option only with Legal sign-off.

Ben: can you prepare the SIG-Mapping.xlsx skeleton (control -> sample artifact -> hashes) and the exemption-letter template? I’ll draft the attestation and include the required control language for SOC 2 / CAIQ crosswalk.

Marissa
Sr. Director, Platform Security — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: presign-ttl-notes.pdf
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Mike — thanks for the patience. We reviewed this with security and ops and can accommodate your request with the following compromise:

Proposed agreement (summary):
- Redwood will upload a 7-day filtered sample (redacted/token-hash mapping) to the Vendr profile for FinCrest.
- We will provide a signed exemption attestation (Redwood template attached) that maps the sample to the relevant SIG/CAIQ control IDs.
- For auditor escalation, FinCrest may request additional presigned bundles. Default presign TTL is 30 days; if you need 90 days we’ll route to Legal and ask FinCrest to provide justification.
- We will not push full production logs into the portal; any additional slices will be delivered as presigned bundles only.

Action items / timeline:
1) Ben to upload SIG-Mapping.xlsx (skeleton) and share with FinCrest for field confirmation. (in-progress)
2) I attached the evidence-exemption-letter-template.docx — we can prefill and sign once you confirm the scope.
3) Please confirm the exact field list and the 7-day window you want us to export by COB 03/26.

HubSpot / next steps: I’ve created a quick ticket in our deal record for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FC-6789. We’ll attach final artifacts there.

If that works, Ben and Marissa will coordinate the upload schedule (we can do a maintenance window for the export if required).
